简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A **Git graphical interface plugin** for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: view, stage, commit, and rever"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"t project changes directly in the browser, while seeing every modification the Agent (harness) makes"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" to workspace files in real time."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Current version: v0.1.2** — Visual operations for viewing changes, committing/reverting, remote "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"synchronization, and more are now available. Branch management, stash, and the AI modification timel"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ine are planned to be completed and released in v0.2.0. See the Roadmap below for details."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Changes View**: Changes are grouped into "Staged / Modified / Untracked / Merge Conflicts". Clic"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"k to view line-level diffs, stage/unstage changes with one click, and discard changes or delete untr"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"acked files with confirmation dialogs.
- **File Tree View**: Browse all files in the workspace (auto"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"matically respecting `.gitignore`). File names are color-coded by status — unmodified files use the "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"default text color (black in light mode / white in dark mode), modified but uncommitted files are **"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"blue**, and untracked files are **red**. Supports directory collapsing and name filtering. Click an "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"unmodified file to preview its contents directly.
- **Log View**: View commit history (hash / refere"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"nce badges / author / relative time), with support for reverting individual commits using `revert`.
"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"- **Nested Repository Detection**: When the session workspace itself is not a Git repository, the pl"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"ugin automatically searches subdirectories for a single nested repository and uses it as the operati"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"on root (for example, when the repository is located in the `dsh-git-gui/` subdirectory of the works"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"pace). If multiple nested repositories are found, the plugin explicitly prompts the user instead of "},{"id":"p7s13","text":"guessing which one to use."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### GitHub Source"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### npm Source"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"After installation, restart `dsh web` and refresh the browser page."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Update"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Where to start"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"After installing the plugin, open the DeepSeek Harness Web UI and click the added button in the bott"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"om-left corner to open the sidebar. Then just enjoy the version control."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Structure"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Roadmap"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Stage | Content | Status |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| v0.1.1 | Changes / file tree / log + commit, stage, discard, revert, **Pull/Push/Fetch + Add Remot"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"e**, dark mode, nested repository detection | ✅ Current version |
| v0.2.0 (unreleased) | **Branch m"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"anagement** (local/remote lists, switch/create, merge, ahead/behind) | 🔧 In progress |
| v0.2.0 (unr"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"eleased) | **Stash** (push/pop/apply/drop) | 🔧 In progress |
| v0.2.0 (unreleased) | **AI modificati"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"on timeline** (session × turn × tool → file attribution view) | 🔧 In progress |
| Future ideas | Res"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"et entry point, file history (`git log -- <path>`), settings card (polling interval / Git path / ide"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"ntity fallback), interactive rebase (PTY) | 💡 To be designed |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- When panel operations and Agent edits occur concurrently, Git's own state is treated as authoritat"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ive. A warning bar is displayed while the session is running, and operations such as discarding chan"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ges require confirmation.
- Untracked file content previews are limited to 512 KiB; diff output is l"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"imited to 4 MiB (truncation is marked); the file tree supports a maximum of 3,000 files.
- Credentia"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ls rely on existing Git credential helpers (WinCred / SSH agent). Interactive password input is disa"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"bled (`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`) to ensure operations do not hang.
- On Windows, if the repository's `"},{"id":"p26s7","text":".git` directory was created by a process running with administrator privileges, tools running with n"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"ormal privileges, such as PyCharm, need to execute `git config --global --add safe.directory '<path>"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"'` (Git 2.35+ hijacking protection).
- The plugin has not yet been tested on macOS or Linux. Please "},{"id":"p26s10","text":"report any issues you encounter."}],"truncated":false}
